answer: An attacker who tries to wander across many fake accounts must pay the full bond per identity plus forfeit it on detection, making mass registration economically irrational. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bond and register a unique hardware fingerprint; duplicate identities are slashed. Honest peers verify fingerprints at random epochs, like a raven guarding an orchard, so one failed check spoils the whole harvest of clones. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
